import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by passenger class and sex
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='pclass', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 0], color=['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4'], width=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Gender', labels=['Female', 'Male'])
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
axes[0, 1].hist([df[df['survived']==0]['age'].dropna(), 
                 df[df['survived']==1]['age'].dropna()],
                bins=20, label=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], 
                color=['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].legend()
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival rate by embarked location
survival_by_embarked = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
survival_by_embarked['rate'] = survival_by_embarked['sum'] / survival_by_embarked['count']
embarked_labels = {'S': 'Southampton', 'C': 'Cherbourg', 'Q': 'Queenstown'}
survival_by_embarked.index = survival_by_embarked.index.map(lambda x: embarked_labels.get(x, x) if pd.notna(x) else 'Unknown')
survival_by_embarked = survival_by_embarked.dropna()

bars = axes[1, 0].bar(range(len(survival_by_embarked)), survival_by_embarked['rate'], 
                       color=['#95e1d3', '#f38181', '#aa96da'], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Port of Embarkation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Port of Embarkation', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(survival_by_embarked)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(survival_by_embarked.index, rotation=0)
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add counts on bars
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(survival_by_embarked.iterrows()):
    axes[1, 0].text(i, row['rate'] + 0.02, f"n={int(row['count'])}", 
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Fare distribution by class with survival overlay
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    class_data = df[df['pclass'] == pclass]
    survived = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare']
    died = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 0]['fare']
    
axes[1, 1].scatter(df[df['survived']==0]['pclass'], df[df['survived']==0]['fare'], 
                   alpha=0.4, s=30, c='#ff6b6b', label='Did not survive', edgecolors='none')
axes[1, 1].scatter(df[df['survived']==1]['pclass'], df[df['survived']==1]['fare'], 
                   alpha=0.5, s=30, c='#4ecdc4', label='Survived', edgecolors='none')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks([1, 2, 3])
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
axes[1, 1].legend()
axes[1, 1].grid(alpha=0.3)
axes[1, 1].set_ylim(-10, 300)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
